amendments.reason: Pre-execution fixture correction: Isamaru has power 2, so use 19 recorded combat damage plus an unblocked attack for 2 to reach exactly 21. Other cases unchanged.

defaults.library: 30 Plains per player; ordered when a fixture can set order
defaults.stateSetup: Direct fixture setup is allowed and must be disclosed; actions under test must use the engine rules path, not mutate the expected outcome.
defaults.opponents: Pass priority unless the scenario says otherwise
defaults.mana: Sufficient untapped basic lands or explicitly disclosed fixture mana; do not disable costs, targeting, SBA, or legality checks

cases.setup: Normal 60-Plains decks, two players, 20 life, player 0 starts; both keep seven.
cases.actions: Use real opening decisions; advance to the first precombat main.
assertions: Both hands contain seven cards
Both libraries contain 53 cards
Starting player skipped their first draw
Player 0 can receive a main-phase decision

cases.setup: Player 0 has two Plains in hand, no lands on battlefield, first precombat main with priority.
cases.actions: Play one Plains; try playing a second; try an action by player 1 while player 0 owns the decision.
assertions: Exactly one Plains moved from hand to battlefield
Second land is unavailable or rejected without mutation
Out-of-turn actor cannot spend player 0's decision

cases.setup: Player 0 has Lightning Bolt and an untapped Mountain; player 1 has 20 life.
cases.actions: Legally cast Bolt targeting player 1, pay R, inspect stack before passing, then resolve.
assertions: Before resolution player 1 has 20 life and Bolt is on stack
After resolution player 1 has 17 life
Bolt is in player 0 graveyard and Mountain is tapped

cases.setup: Player 0 has Lightning Bolt and untapped Mountain; player 1 controls Grizzly Bears with no damage.
cases.actions: Cast Bolt targeting Bears and resolve including SBA.
assertions: Bears and Bolt end in their owners' graveyards
Player 1 still has 20 life
No Bears remains on battlefield

cases.setup: Player 0 has Lightning Bolt and untapped Mountain; player 1 has Counterspell and two untapped Islands.
cases.actions: Cast Bolt targeting player 1; player 1 responds with Counterspell targeting that Bolt; pass to resolve.
assertions: Counterspell is above Bolt on stack before resolving
Bolt deals no damage; both life totals remain 20
Both spells end in their respective graveyards; stack is empty

cases.setup: Player 0 has Elvish Visionary, untapped Forest and Plains, and 30 Plains in library.
cases.actions: Cast Visionary; resolve creature, its ETB trigger, and no draw step.
assertions: Visionary is on battlefield
Exactly one card is drawn from the library
ETB uses the stack and resolves after the creature

cases.setup: Each player controls an untapped Grizzly Bears under their control since turn start; player 0 precombat main.
cases.actions: Advance, attack player 1 with Bears, block with the other Bears, resolve normal combat damage and SBA.
assertions: Both Bears die
Both life totals stay 20
Each Bears is in its owner's graveyard

cases.setup: Normal game with distinct named secret cards in each player's hand and library; also include a public Grizzly Bears.
cases.actions: Obtain owner, opponent and spectator projections through the candidate's actual external view seam.
assertions: Owner can identify own hand
Opponent and spectator cannot recover other hands' card identities or private card text through nested fields
Library identities/order are private even to owner unless a rule reveals them
Public Bears and public zone counts remain visible

cases.setup: Four-player free-for-all, 20 life each, player 0 owns a pending actionable decision; player 2 owns a public Bears.
cases.actions: Player 2 concedes; player 0 completes the pending or refreshed decision; then players 1 and 3 concede.
assertions: First departure leaves three players and does not end the game
Departing player's owned Bears leaves the game
A remaining player can continue through a decision
Only after all other opponents leave is player 0 the winner

cases.setup: Four-player Commander, 40 life, player 0 commander Isamaru, Hound of Konda in command zone; sufficient Plains; all other commanders valid.
cases.actions: Cast Isamaru for W; destroy it using a real effect; choose command-zone return; cast it again paying 2W.
assertions: All players start at 40 life and commanders start in command zones
Commander return is optional and actually offered
Second command-zone cast costs 2W; insufficient W alone cannot cast it
Commander ends on battlefield after paid recast

cases.setup: Four-player Commander, defender at 40 life with 19 previously recorded combat damage from the same Isamaru commander; commander able to attack unblocked. Separately test damage flagged noncombat against a fresh fixture.
cases.actions: Attack unblocked with the 2/2 commander for two combat damage and evaluate SBA. In the separate fixture deal two noncombat damage from the commander and inspect the commander-damage counter.
assertions: Defender loses at 21 damage from that commander despite positive life
Other players continue
Noncombat damage is not added to commander combat damage

cases.setup: Player 0 has Lovestruck Beast, sufficient Forests and Plains, no other creatures.
cases.actions: Cast Heart's Desire for G and resolve; then cast the same card as Lovestruck Beast from exile for 2G.
assertions: Adventure creates one white 1/1 Human token
Lovestruck Beast goes to exile after successful Adventure
Creature can then be cast from exile and enters battlefield as 5/5

cases.setup: Player 0 has Bala Ged Recovery // Bala Ged Sanctuary, no land played this turn.
cases.actions: Play the land face; advance through untap; activate its mana ability.
assertions: Bala Ged Sanctuary enters tapped as a land without casting the sorcery
No Bala Ged Recovery sorcery effect occurs
It can later tap to produce G

cases.setup: Player 0 has Willbender and five untapped lands including an Island.
cases.actions: Cast it face down for 3; inspect stack and battlefield projections; resolve; turn face up for 1U with no other spell on stack.
assertions: Face-down spell/permanent is colorless nameless 2/2 with no abilities or mana cost as applicable
Opponent/spectator projections do not expose Willbender identity on stack or battlefield
Turning face up preserves permanent identity and becomes Willbender 1/2

cases.setup: Rest in Peace is already on battlefield, each graveyard empty; player 1 controls Grizzly Bears; player 0 has Bolt and Mountain.
cases.actions: Cast Bolt on Bears and resolve.
assertions: Lethally damaged Bears goes to exile, not graveyard
Resolved Bolt goes to exile, not graveyard
Both graveyards remain empty

cases.setup: Player 1 controls Grizzly Bears currently receiving +3/+3 from a resolved Giant Growth this turn; player 0 has Clone and sufficient mana.
cases.actions: Cast Clone choosing to copy Bears.
assertions: Clone enters as a Grizzly Bears copy
Clone is 2/2 and does not copy the temporary +3/+3 effect
Original Bears remains 5/5 this turn

cases.setup: Player 0 has Raise the Alarm, untapped Plains and another untapped Plains, and no creatures.
cases.actions: Cast Raise the Alarm and resolve.
assertions: Exactly two white 1/1 Soldier creature tokens enter under player 0's control
Raise the Alarm enters the graveyard
No token card is removed from the player's library or hand

extensions.reason: Freeze a separate Oracle-backed fixture before testing Emeritus of Truce // Swords to Plowshares; older feature-name or catalog checks are not a behavioral pass.
Obtain representative owner decks or explicitly label synthetic decks; count supported interactions, not parser acceptance.
Sequential controlled release runs only after shared correctness qualification; cold startup and warmed turn latency measured separately.
Finalist-only isolated Hexproof integration trial; no claim based on upstream GUI, existing Forge-only GUI, or headless tests.
